spans.s: añjaṣṭa-sabhā, añjaṣṭa-śattu-sabhai (SITI), Tamil-Sanskrit; village committee of five or eight members. Cf. pañca-kula and aṣṭa-kula.
añjuvaṇṇam (SITI; EI 35), Tamil; Sanskrit pañca-varṇa; the five artisan classes; called hañjamāna in Kannaḍa inscriptions; sometimes regarded as a form of Persian anjuman.
